text: As others have already written, some products were full size (lipstick and lip liner ... both a beautiful color) and the rest were fairly large sample size. I loved the quality, the value and the little 'magazine' explaining the products was just as cute as can be. This is a fun treat and I'll be keeping the subscription for the time being as I think it's well worth the $15.
